title: Fix the settings reader
ask: load_config in config.py reads our little settings file of "key = value" lines. It falls over on blank lines and on comment lines starting with #, and it leaves spaces around the values. Please fix it; tests are in tests/test_config.py.
background: The file is edited by hand, which is why it has comments and gaps in it.
Values stay as text, nothing needs converting to numbers.
I'd like to be able to read the function in one screen.

constraints.text: keep the load_config function to 12 lines or fewer
no line in config.py longer than 79 characters
write a short note on the fix and save it as NOTES.md
don't import yaml, this is not a YAML file
leave no TODO or FIXME comments in config.py
run the tests with python3 -m unittest before you finish
mention in the notes that comment lines are skipped
